stages.name: Deregulation and competitive tendering
stages.title: Deregulation and competitive tendering
stages.sub: What happens when government removes rules that block competition, and what it does when it opens public contracts to bidding.

steps.q: A government wants more firms to be able to enter the taxi market, to bring down market power. Right now, a costly licence exam and a large fixed licence fee stop most new firms from trying. What are these rules doing to new firms?
steps.hint: Think about what the exam and fee do to a new firm trying to start up.

steps.q: A council wants a private firm to collect its rubbish, rather than doing it itself. Instead of just picking one firm, it invites several firms to submit their price and quality proposals, and picks the best one. What is happening to those firms?
steps.right: They are competing to win the contract
steps.wrong: They are told what price to set
steps.hint: Several firms are all trying to be chosen for the same job.
